news.headline: Tokyo shares are higher as easing worries over inflation reduce odds for another Fed rate hike
news.summary: TOKYO (AP) — Tokyo shares advanced Monday at the start of a busy week for U. economic updates, while stock prices were little changed in Sydney and Hong Kong.

news.headline: Japanese chipmakers rally as Micron earnings boost AI trade
news.summary: Investing.com-- Japanese chip stocks surged on Thursday, tracking a stronger-than-expected outlook from U.S. memory-chip maker Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) and renewed optimism over AI-related semiconductor demand.

news.headline: Asia stocks rise on chipmaker gains, soft U.S. inflation; Nikkei outperforms
news.summary: Investing.com-- Asian stocks were mostly higher on Thursday, with Japanese chipmakers leading gains after strong results from Micron Technology, while softer-than-expected U.S. inflation data eased expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike this month.

news.headline: Asian shares mostly rise amid market optimism about AI, despite Iran worries
news.summary: Asian shares mostly rose in early Thursday trading amid investor interest in technology-related issues, despite ongoing worries about the war in Iran.  In Tokyo trading, issues expected to get a boost from the solid demand in computer chips and AI-related growth have been rising in recent sessions, including Advantest Corp., Tokyo Electron and SoftBank Group Corp.
